concepts.target_customer: Children ages 6–12 who enjoy cosy craft-themed colouring
concepts.short_description: A 10-page autumn colouring book centred on a cheerful young maker creating seasonal decorations, gifts and keepsakes in a snug craft room. Each page offers one clear, colourable autumn project with friendly storybook detail.
key_features: A4 and US Letter home-printing guidance
concepts.visual_direction_summary: A gentle indoor autumn route built around handmade seasonal projects, cosy furnishings and expressive child-friendly character moments. The pages move between simple makes such as garlands, lanterns, paper leaves and knitted accessories while retaining clear focal shapes.

visual_route.composition: Large worktable focal point with shelves in shallow background
visual_route.palette_emphasis: Suggested amber, russet, cream and walnut tones
visual_route.typography_approach: Simple hand-lettered cover title, text-free interiors
visual_route.distinguishing_visual_hook: Child assembling a long leaf garland

concepts.preview_brief: Portrait cover showing a smiling young craft maker at a broad table, threading a leaf garland beneath a rounded window with raindrops outside. Craft shelves, jars and folded blankets create a cosy shallow background, with an open hand-lettered title area above.

concepts.proposed_name: The Apple Pie Kitchen Colouring Book
concepts.target_customer: Children ages 6–12 who enjoy food, animals and cosy home scenes
concepts.short_description: A 10-page autumn colouring book following a gentle hedgehog baker through a warm day of apple pies, cinnamon buns and shared kitchen treats. Each scene uses broad food shapes, friendly animal expressions and welcoming home details.
key_features: Broad, colourable food and kitchen shapes
A4 and US Letter home-printing guidance
concepts.visual_direction_summary: A food-led autumn route with a softly stylised hedgehog baker, rounded kitchenware and simple seasonal baking moments. The book focuses on mixing, rolling, cooling and sharing treats rather than market or travel scenes.

visual_route.composition: Central baking counter with curved cupboards behind
visual_route.palette_emphasis: Suggested apple red, cinnamon, cream and copper tones
visual_route.typography_approach: Rounded bakery-style cover title, text-free interiors
visual_route.distinguishing_visual_hook: Hedgehog lifting a steaming apple pie

concepts.preview_brief: Portrait cover showing a gentle hedgehog baker lifting a freshly baked apple pie from a low oven in a rounded country kitchen. Apples, a rolling pin and a cooling rack frame the scene, while a clear bakery-style title sits in the upper space.

concepts.tagline: Garden calm for cosy autumn days
concepts.target_customer: Children ages 6–12 who enjoy gardens, nature and gentle characters
concepts.short_description: A 10-page autumn colouring book set in a welcoming backyard greenhouse, where a curious young gardener tends seedlings, gathers seeds and shelters from a gentle rain shower. Each page combines easy-to-colour plants, tools and cosy glasshouse details.
key_features: Clear plant shapes and open colouring spaces
A4 and US Letter home-printing guidance
concepts.visual_direction_summary: A rain-kissed garden route with a young gardener, rounded greenhouse architecture and autumn plant care. Pages feature seed saving, potting, watering, bird watching and rain shelter, with broad botanical forms rather than dense foliage.

visual_route.composition: Open greenhouse doorway framing gardener and potting bench
visual_route.palette_emphasis: Suggested moss green, pumpkin orange and misty blue tones
visual_route.typography_approach: Neat garden-label cover title, text-free interiors
visual_route.distinguishing_visual_hook: Child sorting seeds while rain taps the glass

concepts.preview_brief: Portrait cover showing a curious child gardener at a potting bench inside an open greenhouse, sorting seed packets as rounded raindrops tap the glass panes. Pots, broad leaves and a small watering can frame the lower area, leaving airy title space overhead.

pages.title: The Apple Pie Kitchen Colouring Book
pages.concept: A gentle hedgehog baker lifts a freshly baked apple pie from a low oven in a welcoming country kitchen.
pages.artwork_description: Illustrated front cover with the hedgehog baker in a simple apron at the central oven, carefully holding a steaming lattice-topped apple pie. Curved cupboards, a cooling rack, a bowl of apples and a rolling pin frame the kitchen scene. The title occupies clear upper space in rounded bakery-style lettering.
pages.generation_prompt: Front cover artwork. Exact title text: “The Apple Pie Kitchen Colouring Book”. A gentle hedgehog baker wearing a simple apron lifts a steaming lattice-topped apple pie from a low oven at centre; rounded country-kitchen cupboards behind, with apples in a bowl, rolling pin and cooling rack as balanced framing details; leave a clear upper area for the exact title.
pages.production_notes: Verify the cover title exactly, including British spelling of “Colouring”. Keep lettering large, legible and separate from the illustration. This is the only page with printed title text; do not add a byline, logo, badge or page count.

pages.title: Apple Picking
pages.concept: The hedgehog gathers apples for the day’s baking beside a small kitchen-garden tree.
pages.artwork_description: A broad, low apple tree fills the upper half of the scene. The hedgehog baker stands below with a large handled basket containing six apples, reaching for one more apple on a low branch. Fallen leaves, three apples on the grass and a cottage window in the distance create a simple autumn setting.
pages.generation_prompt: Text-free interior colouring page: the hedgehog baker in a simple apron gathers apples beneath a broad low apple tree, reaching toward one apple on a low branch and holding a large handled basket containing exactly six apples; exactly three fallen apples on the ground, a few large autumn leaves, and a distant cottage window. Keep apples large and clearly separated.
pages.production_notes: Check exact item count: six apples in the basket, one apple being reached for on the branch, and three apples on the ground. Ensure every apple is a distinct, colourable enclosed shape.

pages.title: Mixing the Filling
pages.concept: The hedgehog mixes apple slices, cinnamon and sugar in a large bowl on the baking counter.
pages.artwork_description: Central close kitchen-counter scene with the hedgehog stirring a large mixing bowl using a wooden spoon. Four chunky apple slices are visible at the top of the bowl. A cinnamon stick jar, small measuring cup, flour sack and checked tea towel sit around the bowl, with curved cupboards behind.
pages.generation_prompt: Text-free interior colouring page: central kitchen counter scene of the hedgehog baker stirring a large round mixing bowl with a wooden spoon; exactly four broad apple slices visible at the top of the bowl; nearby cinnamon sticks in a small open jar, one measuring cup, a simple flour sack and a folded checked tea towel; curved cupboards in the background.
pages.production_notes: Ensure exactly four apple slices are visible and large enough to colour. Keep any flour sack unlabelled to avoid unintended text. Do not add recipe wording.

pages.title: Rolling Pastry
pages.concept: The hedgehog rolls a wide round sheet of pie pastry while a mouse helper brings an apple.
pages.artwork_description: A wide worktable stretches across the page. The hedgehog uses a rolling pin over a large circular pastry sheet, while a small friendly mouse at the side carries one apple in both paws. A pie dish, flour bowl and three leaf-shaped pastry cut-outs form clear supporting details.
pages.generation_prompt: Text-free interior colouring page: wide baking worktable with the hedgehog baker rolling a large circular pastry sheet using a rolling pin; a small friendly mouse helper carries exactly one apple at one side; include one empty pie dish, one small flour bowl and exactly three large leaf-shaped pastry cut-outs, all clearly separated.
pages.production_notes: Check exact count of three leaf-shaped pastry cut-outs and one apple carried by the mouse. Keep the pastry circle broad and free of dense texture so it is colourable.

pages.title: Pie in the Oven
pages.concept: The hedgehog checks a lattice apple pie baking in the low oven.
pages.artwork_description: The open low oven is the focal point, holding one round lattice-topped apple pie on its rack. The hedgehog kneels nearby wearing an oven mitt and peeks in happily. A kitchen clock, hanging oven mitt, kettle and a few large leaves in a jar provide cosy background detail.
pages.generation_prompt: Text-free interior colouring page: open low country-kitchen oven as the main focal point, with exactly one round lattice-topped apple pie on the oven rack; the hedgehog baker kneels nearby in a simple apron, wearing one oven mitt and smiling as they look inside; include a round kitchen clock, one hanging oven mitt, a kettle and a jar holding a few large autumn leaves.
pages.production_notes: There must be exactly one pie inside the oven. Make oven bars and lattice strips bold and widely spaced, avoiding narrow, difficult-to-colour gaps.

pages.title: Cinnamon Bun Swirls
pages.concept: The hedgehog arranges cinnamon buns on a tray while dough spirals decorate the counter.
pages.artwork_description: A top-forward counter composition shows a rectangular baking tray with five large spiral cinnamon buns. The hedgehog’s paws place the final bun on the tray. A rolling pin, a small bowl of icing and two loose dough spirals sit nearby, with a simple tiled splashback behind.
pages.generation_prompt: Text-free interior colouring page: baking counter viewed slightly from above, dominated by a rectangular tray holding exactly five large spiral cinnamon buns; the hedgehog baker’s paws gently place the fifth bun on the tray; include a rolling pin, one small bowl of icing and exactly two loose dough spirals beside the tray, with simple large kitchen tiles behind.
pages.production_notes: Verify tray count: exactly five buns. The two loose dough spirals must be clearly distinct from the buns. Use broad spiral lines with open colouring spaces.

pages.title: Cooling Rack Treats
pages.concept: Fresh pies and buns cool by an open window while autumn leaves drift outside.
pages.artwork_description: A tall open kitchen window provides the main backdrop. A cooling rack beneath it holds two small apple hand pies and three cinnamon buns. The hedgehog stands beside the rack, holding a tea towel. Outside, a simple tree branch with five large leaves curves into view.
pages.generation_prompt: Text-free interior colouring page: open country-kitchen window above a central cooling rack; the rack holds exactly two small apple hand pies and exactly three cinnamon buns; the hedgehog baker stands beside it holding a folded tea towel; outside the window, show one simple tree branch with exactly five large autumn leaves.
pages.production_notes: Check fixed counts: two hand pies, three cinnamon buns and five leaves on the outside branch. Preserve open spaces between rack bars and baked goods.

pages.title: Setting the Tea Table
pages.concept: The hedgehog prepares a cosy table for friends with pie slices, cups and autumn flowers.
pages.artwork_description: A round table is set for three animal friends. It holds three patterned cups, three plates each with one apple pie slice, and a small vase of large autumn flowers. The hedgehog straightens a napkin while a squirrel and rabbit wait on rounded chairs in the background.
pages.generation_prompt: Text-free interior colouring page: round tea table set for three in a cosy kitchen, with exactly three patterned cups and exactly three plates, each plate holding one apple pie slice; a small vase of large autumn flowers sits at centre; the hedgehog baker straightens one napkin while a friendly squirrel and rabbit wait on rounded chairs behind the table.
pages.production_notes: Verify exactly three cups, three plates and three pie slices. Characters should have clear, friendly expressions and not overlap tableware confusingly.

pages.title: Sharing Apple Pie
pages.concept: The hedgehog and two friends enjoy a cheerful slice of pie together.
pages.artwork_description: A warm seated scene centres on the hedgehog, squirrel and rabbit around a small table. Each friend holds a fork above a plate with one pie slice. A whole lattice pie rests on a sideboard behind them, while a window shows a few broad falling leaves.
pages.generation_prompt: Text-free interior colouring page: cosy sharing scene with the hedgehog baker, a friendly squirrel and a friendly rabbit seated around a small table; each of the three characters has one plate with one apple pie slice and holds one fork; behind them, a sideboard holds exactly one whole lattice-topped apple pie; a small window shows a few broad falling autumn leaves.
pages.production_notes: Check there are exactly three seated characters, three individual pie slices and one whole pie on the sideboard. Keep faces and forks distinct, with no tiny food details.

pages.title: A Cosy Kitchen Goodbye
pages.concept: At the end of the baking day, the hedgehog waves from the tidy kitchen beside a basket of treats.
pages.artwork_description: The hedgehog baker waves from the central kitchen counter, with a gingham cloth and a basket holding one whole pie and four cinnamon buns. The low oven is closed, dishes are neatly stacked, and a crescent moon with two stars appears through the window, ending the story on a peaceful evening note.
pages.generation_prompt: Text-free interior colouring page: peaceful end-of-day country kitchen, with the hedgehog baker smiling and waving from behind the central counter; a gingham cloth and a basket hold exactly one whole apple pie and exactly four cinnamon buns; show the closed low oven, a neat stack of three dishes, and a window with one crescent moon and exactly two stars.
pages.production_notes: Check exact counts: one whole pie, four cinnamon buns, three stacked dishes and two stars. Keep the moon and stars simple and modest, with no dark night fill. Include A4 and US Letter printing guidance as separate unillustrated deliverable files, not as book pages.

selected_pages.reason: First illustration-led page (colouring): sets the core illustration style.
A different page type (colouring) tests a different layout and activity structure.
A later page (colouring, p10) checks the shared style stays consistent across the product.
